name: GetAccept
description:
GetAccept is a Digital Sales Room platform where revenue teams share proposals, contracts, and sales content with buyers

This connector gives your AI assistant secure access to your GetAccept workspace, so you can ask about your pipeline instead of clicking through it:

- Deals & dealrooms — list your dealrooms, check deal status, participants, action plans, and conversations, or export dealroom pages for review.
- Documents & e-signatures — look up sent documents, recipients, signing status, field values, comments, and the full document activity log.
- Buyer engagement — see who opened what, how long they spent on each page, and which deals are heating up or going cold.
- Contacts, templates & team — search contacts, browse document and dealroom templates, and look up teammates.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GetAccept to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GetAccept to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getaccept.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GetAccept MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GetAccept lists 23 MCP tools, including create_dealroom_meeting, export_dealroom_pages, get_dealroom, get_dealroom_action_plans, get_dealroom_engagement, get_dealroom_messages, get_document, get_document_comments, get_document_engagement, get_document_field_values, get_document_log, and get_document_template_roles.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GetAccept?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GetAccept in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
GetAccept requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GetAccept is developed by GetAccept. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
